text:
cj: Idea: spawn tiny read-only control-plane replicas inside customer VPCs (Private/Dedicated) so connectors can validate tokens, certs, and routing locally — aim is lower handshake latency and reduced egress for high-churn customers.

neha: Reduced surface only: tenant config, public certs, revocation list subset. No signing keys stored. Writes still to central CP.

cj: Sync model: CDC stream for critical events (revocations, pin/unpin) with <1s target, plus 30s snapshots for everything else. If stream fails, replica falls back to polling.

frank: Main risks: stale revocations, onboarding complexity, audit log shipping. Mitigations: short-lived replica certs, revoke-push from central CP, and signed manifests shipped back for audits.

neha: Security bootstrap: operator requests replica cert from central CP; cert bound to tenant-id + VPC CIDR; mTLS for streams. Replica responds /health with states (healthy,degraded,stale).

cj: Connector behavior: prefer local replica if healthy && lag<threshold, else fallback. Add metrics: replica_stream_lag_ms, replica_snapshot_age_s, replica_failover_count.

frank: Rollout plan: pilot in one region for non-sensitive tenants behind feature flag; add kill-switch to revoke certs centrally. I'll prototype operator scripts.

deploy-bot: @frank started canary rollout: cp-replica -> staging (4%) at 2026-01-04T12:00:00Z.
